run_multiclass_nms: run multiclass NMS on bounding boxes and scores with configurable IoU threshold and max detections
run_fast_nms: run fast NMS from YOLACT on bounding boxes, scores, and mask coefficients with IoU thresholding
test_multiclass_nms: test multiclass_nms function with sample bboxes and scores to verify correct NMS filtering
review_multiclass_nms: review the multiclass_nms function for ONNX export compatibility and TensorRT support
refactor_fast_nms: refactor fast_nms to support configurable box dimensions beyond the default 4
